name: Craiova Rubik Open 2017
information:
Competitor entry fee: 25 RON / Family
Mercur Center is a shoping center and also has a food court at 3rd floor, wich is ideal for guests.

At the registration you can support the association "Asociatia Romana de Speedcubing" with a contribution and you will get a cubing prize. 
More details on http://www.speedcubing.ro/craiova-rubik-open-2017/

Prizes
Certificates and medals for top 3 of each event and for the fastest girl, youngest competitor, oldest competitor and fastest competitor of each country (who register until 11.11.2017)
